title: Most powerful new animals
hook: WE JUST ADDED 48 ANIMALS. THESE ARE THE 5 STRONGEST.
subtitle: Ranked by power index, which combines all six battle ratings.
outro: WHICH ANIMAL SHOULD WE ADD NEXT?
caption: 48 new animals just joined Animal Battle Stats, from the Titan Beetle to the Sperm Whale. Here are the 5 most powerful. What should we add next?

facts.sperm-whale: A typical hunting dive lasts about 45 minutes, deep in the dark ocean.
facts.asian-elephant: One passed the mirror test at the Bronx Zoo: it recognised itself in a mirror.
facts.humpback-whale: Humpbacks often charge in to break up orca attacks, even to protect seals and other whales.
facts.mako-shark: The highest-leaping shark: a mako can jump about 6 m out of the water.
facts.bengal-tiger: A tiger can leap about 6 m in a single bound.
